# Double instructions

The `.double` stack holds 64-bit floating-point numbers. No instruction leaves a NaN or an infinity on the stack: a result that would be one is refused instead.

## The stack's own instructions

Every stack has the same family for copying, deleting, reordering and measuring its items; see <doc:StackInstructions>. On `.double` they are `doubleDeepDup`, `doubleDeleteAtDepth`, `doubleDup`, `doubleDupItems`, `doubleDupTimes`, `doubleFlush`, `doublePop`, `doublePopItems`, `doubleRot`, `doubleShove`, `doubleStackDepth`, `doubleStackIsEmpty`, `doubleSwap`, `doubleYank`, `doubleYankDup`.
